t: The Webmaster's New Tools: HTTP Status Codes & Browser Control via Nix/Selenium
s: This article details using Nix for reproducible cross-platform development environments to build a browser automation system. It explores the practical decision to use Selenium 4.x over Playwright/Puppeteer for its loose coupling and AI assistant compatibility, while addressing the challenge of efficiently retrieving HTTP response headers.
sub: Browser automation choice: Selenium vs. Playwright/Puppeteer
